description.en: Connects a chat platform (OneBot, QQ, Discord, Telegram, WeChat, Web) to the message pipeline, and its login flows.
description.zh: 把聊天平台（OneBot、QQ、Discord、Telegram、微信、Web）接进消息管道，以及对应的登录流程。

description.en: Implements how a turn is generated: a concrete engine (character roleplay, ...) or a turn policy (model selection).
description.zh: 决定一个回合如何生成：具体的引擎实现（如角色扮演），或回合策略（如模型选择）。

description.en: Reaches model APIs: provider adapters, endpoint formats, the provider catalog, and execution backends that fill a model-shaped seam.
description.zh: 对接模型 API：provider 适配器、端点格式、provider 目录，以及填充模型类接缝的执行后端。

description.en: Context that outlives a turn: long-term memory, compaction, session persistence, history folding and retrieval backends.
description.zh: 跨越回合的上下文：长期记忆、压缩、会话持久化、历史折叠与检索后端。

description.en: Callable capability: tool sets, skills, subagents, execution machines, schedules, MCP, search, and the seams they plug into.
description.zh: 可调用的能力：工具集、技能、子代理、执行机器、定时任务、MCP、搜索，以及它们的接缝。

description.en: What the model is told: persona/preset formats and loaders, prompt templates, prompt variables.
description.zh: 告诉模型什么：人格/预设格式与加载器、提示词模板、提示词变量。

description.en: Turns model output into media or platform text: image generation, speech, image descriptions and previews, element conversion.
description.zh: 把模型输出变成媒体或平台文本：生图、语音、图片描述与预览、元素转换。

description.en: A page or control surface: management pages, the chat app, the shell, the page and slot APIs that let other plugins add pages.
description.zh: 页面或控制面板：管理页、聊天应用、外壳，以及让其他插件添加页面的页面与插槽 API。

description.en: Infrastructure the rest builds on: routing, permissions, sessions, trace, background work, credentials, runtime, API server.
description.zh: 其余功能依赖的基础设施：路由、权限、会话、追踪、后台任务、凭据、运行时、API 服务。

description.en: Not classified yet, or a utility/library rather than an installable plugin.
description.zh: 尚未分类，或是工具库/库而非可安装插件。

description.en: Built for the LivingSystem ecosystem, this long-term memory plugin gives your bot’s memories a voice of their own. Your bot recalls and organizes memories in the background, telling the story of your time together without pausing the conversation.
description.zh: LivingSystem 生态下构筑的长期记忆插件，让 bot 的记忆带上生动的人格化色彩。通过异步、非阻塞的记忆召回和记忆整理流程让 bot 记叙共度的时光。

package.name: chatluna-plugin-livingmemory
package.description: LivingSystem 生态下构筑的长期记忆插件，让 bot 的记忆带上生动的人格化色彩。通过异步、非阻塞的记忆召回和记忆整理流程让 bot 记叙共度的时光。
